svg.title: QRNG vs. SRAM start-up noise
svg.desc: How much entropy does an ESP32's free SRAM start-up noise carry next to a real quantum computer? Random bits from a 100+ qubit IBM Heron processor and from unstable SRAM cells go through the same NIST pipeline: SP 800-90B min-entropy, extraction, then SP 800-22.
svg.text: How much entropy does an ESP32's free SRAM noise
carry next to a real quantum computer?
